T/OWho we are

Independent aviation auditing and consulting

Vektor is an independent aviation auditing and consulting company. We give operators an objective view of where they stand against the rules, and practical support to close the gaps.

Our core is business and corporate aviation: private jet and helicopter operators, aircraft management companies, FBOs, ground handlers and flight support providers. We also support airlines, cargo, training organisations and general aviation.

We combine audit discipline with hands-on operational experience, so you know what the authority expects and how to meet it in real operating conditions.

Clarity and confidence in aviation compliance and operations.

CLBServices

What we do

Choose a single task or ongoing support. We work on site or remotely, and you keep full ownership of everything we produce.

AUDServices

Aviation auditing

Audits show where you stand against every rule that applies to you, national and international, and give you a clear path to close each gap before the authority finds it.

How we get you there

  1. 01

    Scope and criteria

    We list the requirements that apply to you: national authority, EASA, ICAO, FAA or UK CAA, plus your own manuals and contracts.

  2. 02

    Document review

    Exposition, manuals, procedures and records are checked against those requirements before we go on site.

  3. 03

    On-site audit

    Interviews, sampling and observation of real work, on the line, at the hangar or in the office.

  4. 04

    Findings with evidence

    Each finding is classified (level 1, level 2 or observation) and backed by the evidence an inspector would expect.

  5. 05

    Root cause and action plan

    For every finding we find the root cause and agree corrective and preventive actions, owners and deadlines.

  6. 06

    Verification and closure

    We check the evidence, confirm the actions work and feed the result back into your audit programme.

Types of audit

  • Regulatory compliance audit
  • Internal audit within your compliance monitoring programme
  • SMS effectiveness audit
  • Supplier and subcontractor audit
  • Mock inspection before an authority visit
  • Due diligence audit for mergers, acquisitions and leases

What you receive

  • Audit report with classified findings
  • Root cause for each finding
  • Corrective action plan template
  • Closure verification

Regulatory references

  • Reg. (EU) 2018/1139
  • Reg. (EU) 965/2012 · ORO.GEN.200
  • ICAO Annex 6
  • ICAO Annex 19
  • 14 CFR Part 5 (FAA)
  • UK Air Operations Regulation
  • ISO 19011
OPSServices

Flight & ground operations

Flight and ground operations that are organised, controlled and supervised the way the authority expects, and that work every day on the line.

How we get you there

  1. 01

    Define the operation

    Type of operation (CAT, NCC, SPO), fleet, areas, specific approvals and the rules that follow from them.

  2. 02

    Organisation and post holders

    Clear responsibilities for flight operations, ground operations and crew training, with operational control defined.

  3. 03

    Procedures

    Operations Manual parts A to D, flight planning, fuel policy, MEL use, ground handling, loading and dispatch.

  4. 04

    Operational control

    Flight watch, weather and NOTAM, flight time limitations and crew rest monitoring.

  5. 05

    Supervision of providers

    Contracts, service levels and audits for handlers, FBOs, fuel and de-icing providers.

  6. 06

    Monitoring

    Line checks, ramp inspection results, KPIs and occurrence data, fed back into your SMS.

Ground operations

  • Ground handling agreements and oversight
  • Aircraft loading, mass and balance
  • Fuelling and de-icing procedures
  • Passengers, baggage and dangerous goods
  • Ramp safety

What you receive

  • Gap analysis against the applicable rules
  • Procedure set ready for approval
  • Operational control model
  • Provider oversight plan
  • Operations KPI dashboard

Regulatory references

  • Reg. (EU) 965/2012 · Part-ORO, CAT, NCC, SPO
  • ORO.FTL
  • ICAO Annex 6 · Parts I, II, III

  • IATA IGOM / AHM

DOCServices

Manuals & documentation

Manuals the authority accepts and your people actually use: one structure, one revision system, one clear voice for every department.

How we get you there

  1. 01

    Map the requirements

    We list the content each manual must cover, for example ORO.MLR.100 for the Operations Manual and ICAO Annex 6.

  2. 02

    Document architecture

    One manual system across departments, with a cross-reference matrix so nothing is duplicated or missing.

  3. 03

    Write and align

    Plain-language procedures that match how you really work, each paragraph traced to its requirement.

  4. 04

    Forms and tools

    Forms, checklists, flowcharts and templates each department needs to run the operation.

  5. 05

    Review and approval

    Compliance check, submission to the authority and handling of approved and notified changes.

  6. 06

    Document control

    Revision system, list of effective pages, distribution and periodic review.

Manuals by department

  • Operations Manual A, B, C, D
  • Ground Operations Manual
  • Safety Management Manual
  • Compliance Monitoring Manual
  • Security Manual and Part-IS ISMS
  • Training programmes
  • Emergency Response Plan

What you receive

  • Manuals in editable format
  • Compliance cross-reference list
  • Forms and checklists
  • Revision procedure

SMSServices

Safety management

A safety management system that finds hazards early, measures what matters and improves every year, built on the four ICAO components.

How we get you there

  1. 01

    Policy and objectives

    Safety policy, accountable manager commitment, safety manager, safety review board and emergency response plan.

  2. 02

    Hazard identification

    Mandatory and voluntary reporting with a just culture, plus data from audits, FDM and investigations.

  3. 03

    Risk assessment and mitigation

    A risk matrix suited to your operation, tolerability criteria, mitigations and management of change.

  4. 04

    Safety assurance

    Safety performance indicators with targets, monitoring, investigations and internal audits of the SMS.

  5. 05

    Safety promotion

    Training, safety bulletins, lessons learned and two-way communication with staff.

  6. 06

    Continuous improvement

    Management reviews, SMS maturity assessment and new objectives every year.

Typical safety performance indicators

  • Unstable approach rate
  • TCAS RA rate
  • Ground damage events
  • Safety reporting rate
  • Overdue corrective actions

What you receive

  • Safety Management Manual
  • Hazard log and risk register
  • SPI dashboard
  • Investigation templates
  • SMS maturity assessment

Regulatory references

  • ICAO Doc 9859

ISECServices

Part-IS information security

Information security managed the way you manage flight safety: risks known, controls in place, incidents detected and reported, and company data protected at all times.

How we get you there

  1. 01

    Scope and context

    We identify the systems, data and interfaces that could affect aviation safety, and when Part-IS applies to you.

  2. 02

    Risk assessment

    Threats, vulnerabilities and their impact on safety, with a risk treatment plan.

  3. 03

    ISMS and controls

    Policy, roles, access control, backups and supplier security, integrated with your existing management system.

  4. 04

    Detect, respond, recover

    Monitoring, incident response, recovery and reporting to the competent authority.

  5. 05

    People

    Awareness training for all staff and role-based training for key positions.

  6. 06

    Monitor and improve

    Internal audits, compliance monitoring and management review of the ISMS.

Protecting company data

  • Data classification and handling rules
  • Access rights and multi-factor authentication
  • Encrypted backups and recovery tests
  • Secure EFB and mobile devices
  • Security clauses for suppliers and cloud services

What you receive

FDMServices

Flight data monitoring

A flight data programme that reviews every flight, turns events into actions and helps crews and aircraft perform better. Built on hands-on FDM experience with both fixed-wing aircraft and helicopters.

How we get you there

  1. 01

    Programme set-up

    Scope (fixed-wing and rotary-wing), data source, analysis software and roles, including the analyst and the gatekeeper.

  2. 02

    Agreements

    FDM policy and a confidentiality and just culture agreement with the crews, with data protection built in.

  3. 03

    Event definitions

    Events and thresholds per aircraft type and flight phase: unstable approach, high descent rate, hard landing, exceedances.

  4. 04

    Every-flight analysis

    Each flight is processed, events are validated, false events removed and severity classified.

  5. 05

    Crew contact and mitigation

    The gatekeeper contacts the crew confidentially, and actions are agreed for training, procedures or the aircraft.

  6. 06

    Trends and SMS

    Monthly trends, safety performance indicators, bulletins and checks that the actions worked.

Typical mitigation actions

  • Targeted recurrent and simulator training
  • Changes to SOPs or briefings
  • Maintenance checks after load or exceedance events
  • Airport and approach-specific notes
  • Safety promotion bulletins

What you receive

  • FDM procedures
  • Event set per aircraft type
  • Monthly FDM report
  • Crew contact process
  • Trend dashboard

Regulatory references

  • ORO.AOC.130
  • ICAO Annex 6 · flight data analysis
  • EAFDM guidance
  • Reg. (EU) 376/2014 · just culture
  • Reg. (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR)
CERTServices

Certifications

Certification that opens doors with clients and charterers, prepared step by step and kept alive after the audit day.

How we get you there

  1. 01

    Choose the standard

    AOC and approvals, IS-BAO for business aircraft operators, IS-BAH for handlers and FBOs, IOSA for airlines or ISO 9001.

  2. 02

    Gap analysis

    We compare your organisation with every protocol of the chosen standard.

  3. 03

    Implementation

    We close the gaps in manuals, SMS, training and records, building maturity stage by stage.

  4. 04

    Pre-audit

    A mock audit with the standard's own checklist, so audit day holds no surprises.

  5. 05

    Certification audit

    Support during the authority or accredited auditor visit and closure of any findings.

  6. 06

    Maintain and improve

    Renewal audits, progression through IS-BAO stages 2 and 3 and a continuous improvement plan.

Standards we prepare for

Industry standards

Looking to achieve IS-BAO or IS-BAH?

We prepare business aviation operators and handlers for IS-BAO and IS-BAH registration under the standards of the International Business Aviation Council (IBAC). Our work covers readiness only: the formal audit is carried out by an IBAC-accredited auditor.

Our support includes

  • Gap analysis against IS-BAO and IS-BAH
  • Policies, procedures and management system alignment
  • Integration with your operational, safety and quality frameworks
  • Pre-assessment readiness review

Why work with Vektor

  • Independent, aviation-focused advice
  • Deep understanding of SMS, quality and operations
  • Clear separation between advice and formal assessment
  • Practical approach built for business aviation

About

Paulo Cravo

Founder & Principal Consultant

Paulo has worked in civil aviation since 2001. He founded Vektor to give operators direct access to an experienced specialist in safety, compliance and information security, without the overhead of a large consultancy.

His work covers safety management, compliance monitoring and Part-IS for air operators, as well as mandatory reporting to EASA and national authorities. He has been an FDM specialist since 2019 on both fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft, with dedicated training in flight data analysis, and developed his own FDM analysis platform. He works mainly with business and corporate aviation, fixed-wing and rotary-wing, and supports operators across all sectors of the industry.
